title: Bad news, renewals and handovers done well
course_title: Advanced Client Management: Keeping and Growing High-Value Clients

say: Bad news, renewals, and handovers done well.
This is the video for module three of Advanced Client Management.
Every long client relationship includes failures. Clients usually forgive a mistake. What they find hard to forgive is hearing about it late, hearing excuses, or discovering it themselves.

panel.heading: Where strong accounts are tested
items: When the contract comes up for renewal

say: Strong accounts are also tested at renewal, when the client decides whether to keep paying you.

panel.heading: Where strong accounts are tested
items: When the contract comes up for renewal

say: And they are tested when the person managing them changes. This module shows you how to handle all three.

panel.heading: Where strong accounts are tested
items: When the contract comes up for renewal

say: Before you call, prepare the facts, the cause, the impact on the client, two or three options and a remedy. Then call as soon as you know. Serious bad news belongs in a call, not a text message.

panel.heading: Deliver bad news well
items: Confirm in writing the same day

say: Open plainly: I need to tell you about a problem. It is our mistake. Do not blame staff by name.

panel.heading: Deliver bad news well
items: Confirm in writing the same day

say: Explain what it means for their business, then listen without interrupting or defending.

panel.heading: Deliver bad news well
items: Confirm in writing the same day

say: Present your options, agree the next step, and say when you will update them again.

panel.heading: Deliver bad news well
items: Confirm in writing the same day

say: Within the same day, send an email confirming what was agreed. Offer something that repairs the actual damage, such as extra work or extended time, rather than a large discount.

panel.heading: Deliver bad news well
items: Confirm in writing the same day
panel.rule: A remedy should fit the harm. It is not a bribe.

say: Here is a worked example. A design error meant a school's campaign went live five days late. Ada called the head of admissions the morning she learned of it, and said: that is our failure.
She offered to extend the campaign by five days at no cost, plus four hours of extra work, worth 60,000 naira at her rate of 15,000 an hour.
That is about 13% of one month's 450,000 naira fee: meaningful, and affordable.
Now a second person checks every final design two days before launch.

When a client is angry, stay calm and acknowledge the feeling without accepting false facts. If a client becomes abusive or threatening, you may end the call politely and involve your manager. Professional does not mean accepting abuse.

panel.heading: Angry client, or client at fault?
left: Ask for time to check facts
right: Do not blame, do not take blame
Give the new date, offer help

say: When the delay is theirs, point calmly to the agreement. For example: our charter allows two working days for approvals, so the launch moves. Would you like us to prioritise anything?

panel.heading: Angry client, or client at fault?
left: Ask for time to check facts
right: Do not blame, do not take blame
Give the new date, offer help

say: Do not treat renewal as paperwork in the last week. At 90 days, review the health score history, quarterly review notes and hours log.
At 60 days, ask directly about the client's plans for next year and anything they want changed.
Send a written proposal at 45 days, and agree terms by 30 days. This gives time to fix problems and fit the client's budget.
Your costs rise over time: data, fuel for generators, salaries. A fair price adjustment is explained with reasons, given with notice, and linked to value.
Halima proposes 12%. The new fee is 504,000 naira a month, and the yearly value rises from 5,400,000 to 6,048,000 naira.
That is a yearly difference of 648,000 naira.
She gave reasons, offered a choice of a smaller scope at a smaller adjustment, and the school chose the full service.
Accounts are often lost when the account manager changes. Write a handover note so a capable stranger could run the account tomorrow, and tick every item here.
Give the new person their own login and remove the old access. Never pass passwords on in a WhatsApp message.
Then hold a joint call so the client meets the new lead.

panel.heading: Before the old manager steps away

say: To remember. Tell bad news early and own it. Keep remedies proportionate. Start renewal 90 days before the contract ends, with clear reasons for any price change. And hand over accounts with a full note and a joint introduction.

panel.heading: Remember
items: Tell bad news early, by voice, and own it
Start renewal work 90 days before the end
Hand over with a note and a joint call

say: Now script a recovery call, plan one renewal, and draft a handover note with an honest STAR reflection for your playbook.
